root_cause.text: The Tegra CBB fabric lookup tables in `drivers/soc/tegra/cbb/tegra234-cbb.c` stored incorrect target-map length values by using `ARRAY_SIZE` on the wrong arrays, causing target timeout lookup code to iterate past the bounds of the associated fabric target maps.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `[T234_AON_FABRIC_ID]` from `ARRAY_SIZE(tegra234_bpmp_target_map)` to `ARRAY_SIZE(tegra234_aon_target_map)` and `[T234_BPMP_FABRIC_ID]` in `tegra241_cbb_fab_list` from `ARRAY_SIZE(tegra241_cbb_target_map)` to `ARRAY_SIZE(tegra241_bpmp_target_map)`, and the CVE/commit explicitly states this incorrect `ARRAY_SIZE` usage "could cause out-of-bounds access during target timeout lookup."

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The Tegra CBB fabric lookup tables in `drivers/soc/tegra/cbb/tegra234-cbb.c` stored incorrect target-map length values by using `ARRAY_SIZE` on the wrong arrays, causing target timeout lookup code to iterate past the bounds of the associated fabric target maps.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch changes `[T234_AON_FABRIC_ID]` from `ARRAY_SIZE(tegra234_bpmp_target_map)` to `ARRAY_SIZE(tegra234_aon_target_map)` and `[T234_BPMP_FABRIC_ID]` in `tegra241_cbb_fab_list` from `ARRAY_SIZE(tegra241_cbb_target_map)` to `ARRAY_SIZE(tegra241_bpmp_target_map)`, and the CVE/commit explicitly states this incorrect `ARRAY_SIZE` usage "could cause out-of-bounds access during target timeout lookup."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the AON fabric lookup entry to use the correct target map size for `tegra234_aon_target_map`.
intent_record.what: The initializer for `tegra234_cbb_fab_list[T234_AON_FABRIC_ID]` was changed so that its array size argument uses `ARRAY_SIZE(tegra234_aon_target_map)` instead of `ARRAY_SIZE(tegra234_bpmp_target_map)`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the AON fabric entry will now report the correct number of elements for `tegra234_aon_target_map` rather than incorrectly using the size of a different map, preventing mismatched iteration bounds or lookup handling for AON targets.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the BPMP fabric lookup entry to use the correct target-map size for tegra241_bpmp_target_map.
intent_record.what: The initializer for T234_BPMP_FABRIC_ID in tegra241_cbb_fab_list[] was changed so that the ARRAY_SIZE argument now uses tegra241_bpmp_target_map instead of tegra241_cbb_target_map.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the BPMP fabric entry will now report the correct number of elements for its own target map rather than reusing the CBB map's element count, preventing incorrect target-map bounds or mismatched iteration over BPMP targets.

grouping_result.intent: Fix the BPMP fabric lookup entry to use the correct target-map size for tegra241_bpmp_target_map.

consistency_review.core_intent: Correct fabric lookup table entries to use the proper target-map array size for their corresponding target map definitions.

relevance_review.reason: The changes directly fix the root cause by correcting fabric lookup table length fields to use the matching target-map array sizes, preventing out-of-bounds iteration in target timeout lookup code.

candidates.rationale: This AON fabric entry uses the size of the BPMP target map instead of the associated tegra234_aon_target_map, causing later lookup code to use an incorrect length and potentially iterate past the AON map bounds.

This BPMP fabric entry pairs tegra241_bpmp_target_map with the length of tegra241_cbb_target_map, creating a mismatched target-map size that can drive out-of-bounds iteration in target timeout lookup.

vuln_statements.explanation: This entry associates tegra241_bpmp_target_map with the size of a different array, tegra241_cbb_target_map. The mismatched length can cause later target timeout lookup code to iterate beyond the bounds of the BPMP target map.

This fabric lookup entry uses the size of tegra234_bpmp_target_map for an AON target-map entry instead of the associated tegra234_aon_target_map. That incorrect stored length can drive out-of-bounds iteration over the AON target map during lookup.

The vulnerable construct is present in the new per-fabric lookup tables: in `tegra234_cbb_fab_list[]`, the AON entry uses `tegra234_aon_target_map` but sets `max_targets` to `ARRAY_SIZE(tegra234_bpmp_target_map)`, i.e. `[T234_AON_FABRIC_ID] = { "aon-fabric", true, tegra234_aon_target_map, ARRAY_SIZE(tegra234_bpmp_target_map) }`.
